concepts.gloss_en: bringing/actualizing from potential into actual — the process identified with speech (dibbur)

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are the identical philosophical idiom 'from potential to actual,' explicitly tied to speech/dibbur in both LM 25 (שהוא בחינת הדבור) and LM 66 (על ידי שלמות הדבור). The only difference is participle (מוציא) vs. infinitive (להוציא) — pure inflectional variation of the same phrase, not a homograph. Safe merge.
